meta.name: Court TV Legendary Trials
meta.description:
Join your favorite Court TV hosts on Legendary Trials as they revisit the twists and turns of each case – from emotional testimonies to shocking verdicts – all in pursuit of justice.

Shows: Court TV Live, Someone They Knew With Tamron Hall, Sex, Cyanide and a Doctor on the Run Case, Killer Or Cover-Up Murder Trial, Wrong Apartment Murder Trial
Available on: The Roku Channel, Plex
